leadText:
This is the 11th chapter of the Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master! manga. It was first published in the January 2023 issue of CoroCoro Ichiban!, released on November 21, 2022. It is 18 pages long.

It was made available on Weekly CoroCoro Comics on November 27, 2023.
